name: CreateWorkItemNode
label: Create Work Item
description: Creates a new work item in the specified queue.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: QueueName
fields.label: Select Queue
fields.description: Choose the queue in which to create the work item.

fields.name: Description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional description for the work item.

fields.name: WorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the data for the work item in JSON format.

fields.name: IsRetry
fields.label: Is Retry
fields.description: Enable for retry mode. When ON, this node creates the next attempt for an existing work item instead of a brand new item, and the Source Work Item ID and Retry Time fields are shown. When OFF, a new work item is created with a freshly generated identifier and processed immediately.

fields.name: SourceWorkItemId
fields.label: Source Work Item ID
fields.description: The identifier of the existing work item this retry continues. Required when 'Is Retry' is ON so the backend can create the next attempt (with an incremented retry count) for that work item. Leave empty for a brand new item; the backend generates the identifier for you. This field is only applicable if 'Is Retry' is set to true.

fields.name: RetryTime
fields.label: Retry Time
fields.description: Optional. The date and time after which this work item becomes eligible for processing. Leave empty to make the work item available immediately. When set, it must be a future date and time, in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-09-12T14:30:00Z). This field is only applicable if 'Is Retry' is set to true.

fields.name: FileUrls
fields.label: File URLs
fields.description: Optional URLs of files associated with the work item, separated by commas.
